arguments.recommended_next_step: Investigate the disk usage and check for any full disk conditions. Then, address the backlog in the jobs database by identifying and resolving the root cause of the failing jobs. Finally, export the failed_jobs table using pg_dump for the postmortem.
arguments.summary: The issue seems to be related to the pgbouncer service, possibly due to disk being full. Additionally, the failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database needs to be addressed and exported for the postmortem. To start, investigate why jobs are failing and export the failed_jobs table using pg_dump.
